steps.instruction: This is a pure rename of Todo.done to Todo.completed. It must not change any behaviour. Check list(), add(), complete() and run() and make sure nothing still reads or writes a `done` property, including through casts, `any`, string keys or destructuring. Each one must use `completed` and keep exactly the logic it had before. Do not add new filtering to list() and do not change what it does by default: whatever the existing tests in src/commands.test.ts specify is the intended behaviour. Leave the ListOptions.includeDone option name as it is. If nothing needs changing, leave the file untouched.

input.reason: The only failing test is one I wrote myself. It assumed list() hides completed todos by default, which goes beyond a pure rename. None of the owners' existing tests specify that, so I can't tell it was the behaviour before the rename. I'm replacing the acceptance test with checks that only cover the rename. I'm also asking the commands owner to confirm no leftover `done` references remain, without changing behaviour.

content.text: The file already uses `completed` everywhere with no `done` references, so nothing needs changing.
